definitions.explanation: the activity of observing stars and celestial bodies, either casually or as a hobby

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{星見|ほしみ}に{最適|さいてき}だ。
{山|やま}で{星見|ほしみ}をすると{満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: When you stargaze in the mountains, you can see a sky full of stars.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{星見|ほしみ}が{好|す}きで、{天文学|てんもんがく}を{専攻|せんこう}した。
examples.english: I've loved stargazing since childhood, so I majored in astronomy.

notes:
USAGE:
{星見|ほしみ} is a casual, native Japanese word for stargazing. For more formal contexts, {天体観測|てんたいかんそく} (astronomical observation) is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {星見|ほしみ}に{行|い}く (to go stargazing)
- {星見|ほしみ}スポット (stargazing spot)
- {星見|ほしみ}ツアー (stargazing tour)

RELATED WORDS:
- {天体観測|てんたいかんそく} (astronomical observation)
- {流星群|りゅうせいぐん} (meteor shower)
- {望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう} (telescope)
